title: EvidenceEnvelope
description: Shared envelope base for all AEP evidence records. Every evidence type wraps its payload in this envelope, which carries schema_version, trace_id, created_at_ms, evidence_type, payload, metadata, and an optional signature.

evidence_type.description: Discriminator for the kind of evidence enclosed, e.g. 'execution', 'artifact', 'checkpoint', 'replay', 'memory'

payload.description: The evidence content — structure depends on evidence_type

contents.description: The primary evidence payload (opaque per evidence_type)
